sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重塑者》，这是一档关于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店打碟的黑胶唱片时代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每晚都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去工作，把DJ台变成了一个充满50年历史精美文物的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重塑者》吧。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, one by one, executives from some of the country's biggest and most powerful companies were dropping from the president's advisory councils.
sentences.zh: 今天，美国一些最大、最有权势的公司的多位高管，一个接一个地退出了总统的咨询委员会。

sentences.en: Then came the press conference.
sentences.zh: 接着是新闻发布会。

sentences.en: How the nation's top CEOs quickly and decisively voted to cut ties with the CEO president.
sentences.zh: 全国顶级CEO们是如何迅速而果断地投票决定与这位“CEO总统”切断联系的。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, August 17th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月17日，星期四。

sentences.en: I think I knew even over the weekend from a number of people on that council that they were upset.
sentences.zh: 我想我甚至在周末时就从委员会的几位成员那里得知他们很不安。

sentences.en: I mean, so many of them were outraged and I had had sort of some back and forth with them.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们中有许多人感到愤怒，我也曾与他们进行过一些交流。

sentences.en: I didn't think they were going to do anything about it.
sentences.zh: 我原以为他们不会采取任何行动。

sentences.en: And in fact, I was to some degree sort of surprised.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我在某种程度上感到有些惊讶。

sentences.en: Over the past few days,
sentences.zh: 在过去几天里，

sentences.en: Andrew Ross Sorkin has been tracking members of the president's business council as they grew increasingly upset with his response to the violence in Charlottesville.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金一直在追踪总统商业委员会的成员，他们对总统在夏洛茨维尔暴力事件上的回应越来越不满。

sentences.en: Why did you think that?
sentences.zh: 你为什么会那么想？

sentences.en: Why did you think they weren't going to do anything?
sentences.zh: 你为什么认为他们不会采取任何行动？

sentences.en: Because they openly or not so openly, but but at least privately talk about the fear that Donald Trump is going to go after them on Twitter and even more than Twitter.
sentences.zh: 因为他们无论公开还是半公开，至少在私下里都在谈论对唐纳德·特朗普在推特上，甚至在推特之外对他们进行报复的恐惧。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, I think that a lot of them either have direct business with the government or he's going to say some of the consumers or this.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道，我认为他们中的许多人要么与政府有直接业务往来，要么担心他会说些什么，或者诸如此类。

sentences.en: This has just become so political for them.
sentences.zh: 这对他们来说已经变得太政治化了。

sentences.en: And a lot of them want to keep their head down.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人只想保持低调。

sentences.en: Making headlines right now.
sentences.zh: 现在的新闻头条。

sentences.en: Merck CEO Ken Frazier announcing he is resigning from President Trump's American Manufacturing Council in a statement posted on Twitter.
sentences.zh: 默克公司CEO肯·弗雷泽在推特上发表声明，宣布辞去特朗普总统美国制造业委员会的职务。

sentences.en: So Ken Frazier of Merck resigns from the Manufacturing Council Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 所以，默克公司的肯·弗雷泽在周一早上辞去了制造业委员会的职务。

sentences.en: And as a matter of personal conscience, I feel a responsibility to take a stand against intolerance and extremism.
sentences.zh: 出于个人良知，我觉得我有责任站出来反对不宽容和极端主义。

sentences.en: And then Donald Trump goes after him.
sentences.zh: 然后唐纳德·特朗普就对他发起了攻击。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The president has tweeted, now that Ken Frazier of Merck Pharma has resigned from President's Manufacturing Council, he will have more time to, in all caps, lower,
sentences.zh: 总统发推文说，既然默克制药的肯·弗雷泽辞去了总统制造业委员会的职务，他将有更多时间去——全部大写——降低，

sentences.en: rip off drug prices, exclamation point.
sentences.zh: 敲诈药价，感叹号。

sentences.en: And literally that morning, I ran to the office and started writing a column about when are these CEOs going to start doing something about it.
sentences.zh: 那天早上，我真的跑回办公室，开始写专栏，讨论这些CEO们到底什么时候才会开始采取行动。

sentences.en: And you posed the question, like, at what point is enough enough?
sentences.zh: 你提出了这个问题，比如，到什么程度才算够了？

sentences.en: Because privately, they would say, Andrew, this is ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 因为私下里，他们会说，安德鲁，这太荒谬了。

sentences.en: This is craziness.
sentences.zh: 这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: So they were upset about the way he was handling Charlottesville.
sentences.zh: 所以他们对他在夏洛茨维尔事件上的处理方式感到不满。

sentences.en: Oh, by the way, they had been upset about Charlottesville.
sentences.zh: 哦，顺便说一句，他们之前就对夏洛茨维尔事件感到不满。

sentences.en: They were upset about the Paris Accord.
sentences.zh: 他们对《巴黎协定》感到不满。

sentences.en: They were upset about the immigration.
sentences.zh: 他们对移民问题感到不满。

sentences.en: This has been bubbling under the surface for so long.
sentences.zh: 这种情绪已经在表面之下酝酿了很久。

sentences.en: And yet, I was frustrated because privately, off the record, they would say to you, I can't believe what's happening here.
sentences.zh: 然而，我感到沮丧，因为私下里，在非正式场合，他们会对你说，我简直不敢相信这里正在发生什么。

sentences.en: This is crazy.
sentences.zh: 这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: On the record, either no comment or, you know, we like working with the White House or whatever, you know, the language was going to be.
sentences.zh: 但在正式场合，要么是无可奉告，要么就是，你知道，我们喜欢与白宫合作，或者诸如此类的客套话。

sentences.en: And so I literally sent out emails to virtually all of them, not all of them, but a lot of them, Monday morning, urgent Trump, what are you going to do?
sentences.zh: 所以我周一早上给他们几乎所有人——不是全部，但很多人——发了紧急邮件，问特朗普的事，你们打算怎么办？

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And either a lot of them didn't get back to me or a couple of them did and would only talk completely off the record.
sentences.zh: 他们中很多人要么没回我，要么有几个回了，但只愿意在完全非正式的情况下交谈。

sentences.en: And one of them I quoted, not by name, saying, look at what they just did to Ken.
sentences.zh: 其中一个人我引用了他的话，但没提名字，他说，看看他们刚对肯做了什么。

sentences.en: I can't put my head up.
sentences.zh: 我不敢出头。

sentences.en: I knew that they were all talking to each other and that there was a lot of back-channeling with each other.
sentences.zh: 我知道他们都在互相交谈，而且他们之间有很多私下的沟通渠道。

sentences.en: But I had no thought they would actually do anything about it, in part because Trump, of course, Monday afternoon puts out his statement.
sentences.zh: 但我没想到他们真的会采取任何行动，部分原因是特朗普在周一下午发表了他的声明。

sentences.en: Racism is evil.
sentences.zh: 种族主义是邪恶的。

sentences.en: And those who cause violence in its name are criminals and thugs, including the KKK, neo-Nazis, white supremacists,
sentences.zh: 那些以种族主义之名制造暴力的人是罪犯和暴徒，包括三K党、新纳粹分子、白人至上主义者，

sentences.en: and other hate groups that are repugnant to everything we hold dear as Americans.
sentences.zh: 以及其他任何我们作为美国人所珍视的一切所厌恶的仇恨团体。

sentences.en: So I did not think that this was going to end with the rapidity that it did.
sentences.zh: 所以我没想到这件事会以如此迅速的方式结束。

sentences.en: We started to feel it a little bit more Monday night as you started to see people like Kevin Plank from Under Armour, who was on the manufacturing council, go off.
sentences.zh: 周一晚上，我们开始感觉到了一些变化，因为你开始看到像安德玛公司的凯文·普兰克这样的人，他也是制造业委员会的成员，开始行动了。

sentences.en: The CEO of Under Armour is putting out this statement, saying, I am appreciative of the opportunity to have served, but have decided to step down from the council.
sentences.zh: 安德玛的CEO发表了这份声明，说，我很感激有机会服务，但已决定退出委员会。

sentences.en: I love our country and our company.
sentences.zh: 我热爱我们的国家和公司。

sentences.en: He had gotten a real earful earlier in the year from Steph Curry.
sentences.zh: 他今年早些时候从斯蒂芬·库里那里听到了不少批评意见。

sentences.en: Steph Curry is a, not only a basketball player, as you know, but Steph Curry is an Under Armour athlete.
sentences.zh: 如你所知，斯蒂芬·库里不仅是一名篮球运动员，他还是安德玛的签约运动员。

sentences.en: And he was very upset with Kevin about some comments that he made that sounded supportive of the president.
sentences.zh: 他对凯文发表的一些听起来支持总统的言论感到非常不满。

sentences.en: Under Armour CEO Kevin Plank recently called President Trump an asset to the United States.
sentences.zh: 安德玛CEO凯文·普兰克最近称特朗普总统是美国的资产。

sentences.en: Well, via the Mercury News, Steph Curry said, quote, I agree with that description.
sentences.zh: 嗯，据《水星新闻》报道，斯蒂芬·库里说，引用一下，我同意这个描述。

sentences.en: If you remove the et from asset, unquote, my goodness, well, Steph Curry is a close friend of President Obama and one of Under Armour's most high profile athletes.
sentences.zh: 如果你把资产（asset）这个词里的et去掉的话，天哪，好吧，斯蒂芬·库里是奥巴马总统的好友，也是安德玛最高调的运动员之一。

sentences.en: So there was that.
sentences.zh: 所以就是这样。

sentences.en: And then you had Brian Kazanich from Intel.
sentences.zh: 然后是英特尔的布莱恩·科再奇。

sentences.en: Also the CEO of Intel putting out this statement, saying, I resigned because I want to make progress.
sentences.zh: 英特尔的CEO也发表了这份声明，说，我辞职是因为我想取得进展。

sentences.en: While many in Washington seem more concerned with attacking anyone who disagrees with them, we should honor, not attack,
sentences.zh: 当华盛顿的许多人似乎更关心攻击任何不同意他们的人时，我们应该尊重，而不是攻击，

sentences.en: those who have stood for equality and other cherished American values.
sentences.zh: 那些捍卫平等和其他珍视的美国价值观的人。

sentences.en: I hope this will change.
sentences.zh: 我希望这种情况能有所改变。

sentences.en: But the main council, the big deal, was always the Schwartzman council.
sentences.zh: 但主要的委员会，那个重头戏，一直都是施瓦茨曼委员会。

sentences.en: Remind me who Steve Schwartzman is and why he matters.
sentences.zh: 提醒我一下史蒂夫·施瓦茨曼是谁，为什么他很重要。

sentences.en: So Steve Schwartzman matters because he runs Blackstone, which is the largest private equity company in the world.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫·施瓦茨曼之所以重要，是因为他经营着黑石集团，这是全球最大的私募股权公司。

sentences.en: It's one of the largest employers in the world.
sentences.zh: 它是全球最大的雇主之一。

sentences.en: He was the person who President Trump tasked early on with creating a committee, creating these relationships with all these CEOs.
sentences.zh: 他就是特朗普总统早期委派负责组建委员会，建立与所有这些CEO联系的人。

sentences.en: Thank you all for being here.
sentences.zh: 感谢大家来到这里。

sentences.en: Very much appreciated.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: I want to thank Steve Schwartzman for putting together this very incredible group of world class business leaders.
sentences.zh: 我要感谢史蒂夫·施瓦茨曼组建了这个非常了不起的世界级商业领袖团队。

sentences.en: That's what you are.
sentences.zh: 你们就是这样的人。

sentences.en: And he put them all together.
sentences.zh: 他把他们都召集在一起。

sentences.en: To advise the president.
sentences.zh: 为总统提供建议。

sentences.en: To advise the president.
sentences.zh: 为总统提供建议。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，总统先生。

sentences.en: Mark Field, CEO of Ford Motor Company.
sentences.zh: 马克·菲尔德，福特汽车公司CEO。

sentences.en: It really is the top CEOs of American business.
sentences.zh: 这确实是美国商界的顶级CEO们。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，总统先生。

sentences.en: Alex Gorski with Johnson & Johnson.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯·戈尔斯基，强生公司。

sentences.en: Doug McMillan, the CEO of Walmart.
sentences.zh: 道格·麦克米伦，沃尔玛CEO。

sentences.en: Ginny Rometty, the CEO of IBM.
sentences.zh: 吉妮·罗曼提，IBM CEO。

sentences.en: Indra Nooyi, the CEO of PepsiCo.
sentences.zh: 英德拉·努伊，百事可乐CEO。

sentences.en: Jack Welch, the former CEO of General Electric.
sentences.zh: 杰克·韦尔奇，通用电气前CEO。

sentences.en: Jamie Dimon, the CEO of J.P.
sentences.zh: 杰米·戴蒙，摩根大通CEO。

sentences.en: Morgan.
sentences.zh: 摩根。

sentences.en: Jim McNerney, the CEO of Boeing.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·麦克纳尼，波音CEO。

sentences.en: Larry Fink, the CEO of BlackRock.
sentences.zh: 拉里·芬克，贝莱德CEO。

sentences.en: Mary Barra, the CEO of General Motors.
sentences.zh: 玛丽·巴拉，通用汽车CEO。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，总统先生。

sentences.en: Denise Morrison from Campbell Soup Company.
sentences.zh: 丹妮丝·莫里森，金宝汤公司。

sentences.en: Good soup.
sentences.zh: 好汤。

sentences.en: So the idea that they would disband was always a little tough.
sentences.zh: 所以他们会解散的想法一直有点难以想象。

sentences.en: So what changes?
sentences.zh: 那么是什么改变了呢？

sentences.en: What changed was Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 改变的是周二。

sentences.en: But you also had people that were very fine people on both sides.
sentences.zh: 但你也有人说双方都有非常好的人。

sentences.en: You had people in that group.
sentences.zh: 那个群体里也有这样的人。

sentences.en: For many of them, this was the end of the line.
sentences.zh: 对他们中的许多人来说，这是底线。

sentences.en: What kind of political pressures were these CEOs facing?
sentences.zh: 这些CEO们面临着什么样的政治压力？

sentences.en: And do you think, and you've been in touch with a bunch of them, do you think that the decision to quit this border, to force its disbanding,
sentences.zh: 你认为——你和他们中的许多人都有联系——你认为退出这个委员会，迫使其解散的决定，

sentences.en: came down to morals, customers, or bottom line, you know, just basically profits of their business?
sentences.zh: 是出于道德、客户，还是底线，你知道，基本上就是他们业务的利润？

sentences.en: To some degree, all of the above.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，以上皆是。

sentences.en: But in this instance, I think the moral issue was a bigger one.
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，我认为道德问题更重要。

sentences.en: So you're saying these were executives who were genuinely offended.
sentences.zh: 所以你是说这些高管是真心感到被冒犯了。

sentences.en: Genuinely offended.
sentences.zh: 真心感到被冒犯了。

sentences.en: And by the way, the greatest leader on this was Ken Frazier of Merck.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，在这方面最伟大的领导者是默克公司的肯·弗雷泽。

sentences.en: Because think about what was at stake for him.
sentences.zh: 因为想想对他来说什么是处于危险之中的。

sentences.en: The largest buyer of drugs in this country is the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这个国家最大的药品买家是美国政府。

sentences.en: government.
sentences.zh: 那是他最大的客户。

sentences.en: That is his biggest customer.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你真的担心某种形式的报复会影响你的底线，那个人就是他。

sentences.en: So if you actually truly fear retribution of some sort to your bottom line, that was the person.
sentences.zh: 所以现在是周三早上。

sentences.en: So it's Wednesday morning.
sentences.zh: 从你的角度来看，这件事是怎么发生的？

sentences.en: How does this go down from your perspective?
sentences.zh: 据我了解，当时安排了一次通话。

sentences.en: My understanding of it is that there's a call set.
sentences.zh: 这个委员会的成员几乎全部，如果不是全部的话，都参加了通话。

sentences.en: Virtually all, if not all, of the members of this council get on the call.
sentences.zh: 大家就总统所说的话、这对他们公司意味着什么、他们的立场进行了真正的讨论。

sentences.en: And there is a real discussion about what the president has said, what it means to their companies, where they stand.
sentences.zh: 他们能解散这个委员会，同时还能与白宫、与华盛顿保持关系吗？

sentences.en: Can they disband this and still have a relationship with the White House, with Washington?
sentences.zh: 商业的角色是什么？

sentences.en: What's the role of business?
sentences.zh: 商业作为道德仲裁者的角色是什么？

sentences.en: What's the role of business as a moral arbiter?
sentences.zh: 我认为有很多不同的观点。

sentences.en: And I think there are lots of different views.
sentences.zh: 我认为所有这些问题都以某种方式进行了讨论。

sentences.en: I think all of those questions were discussed in one way or another.
sentences.zh: 但很快就转到了实际层面，即这一切将如何运作？

sentences.en: But it turned very quickly into the practicality of how is this all going to work?
sentences.zh: 然后据我所知，通话结束了。

sentences.en: And then my understanding is the call ends.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫·施瓦茨曼给白宫打电话，说我们要解散这个小组。

sentences.en: Steve Schwartzman calls the White House, says we're going to disband this group.
sentences.zh: 然后总统做了什么？

sentences.en: And then what does the president do?
sentences.zh: 他发了一条推文说……

sentences.en: He puts out a tweet saying...
sentences.zh: 美国总统刚刚发推文说，约翰，与其给制造业委员会和战略与政策论坛的商界人士施压，

sentences.en: The president of the United States has just tweeted, John, rather than putting pressure on the business people of the Manufacturing Council and Strategy
sentences.zh: 我决定将两者都结束。

sentences.en: and Policy Forum, I am ending both.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家。

sentences.en: Thank you all.
sentences.zh: 你不能甩了我。

sentences.en: You can't break up with me.
sentences.zh: 是我甩了你们。

sentences.en: I'm breaking up with you.
sentences.zh: 更糟糕的是，他说他和该小组已同意解散。

sentences.en: Worse than that, he says that he and the group have agreed to disband.
sentences.zh: 这是一种多大的举动？

sentences.en: And how significant an act is that?
sentences.zh: 这在视觉上是一个重大的举动，在个人层面上，当涉及到总统和他试图为自己塑造的形象时，这也是一个重大的举动。

sentences.en: It's a significant act optically and it's a significant act personally when it comes to the president and the image he has tried to craft about himself.
sentences.zh: 让制造业回归美国，创造高薪就业岗位，是我们竞选的承诺和主题之一。

sentences.en: Bringing manufacturing back to America, creating high-wage jobs, was one of our campaign promises and themes.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，他一直试图将自己描述和描绘成商业总统，CEO总统。

sentences.en: Which is to say that he has tried to describe and portray himself as the business president, as the CEO president.
sentences.zh: 我正在兑现我们所说的一切。

sentences.en: And I'm delivering on everything that we've said.
sentences.zh: 他把所有这些人放在他身边。

sentences.en: And he has put all of these people around him.
sentences.zh: 我甚至听到其中一些人形容自己感觉像是他剧场里的道具。

sentences.en: I've heard some of these people even describe themselves as feeling like they are props in his theater.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，总统先生。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 格雷格·海耶斯，联合技术公司，开利公司的母公司。

sentences.en: Greg Hayes from United Technologies, the parent company of Carrier Corp.
sentences.zh: 你从开利公司带回更多工作岗位了吗？

sentences.en: Did you bring any more of those jobs back from Carrier?
sentences.zh: 但他做了一件事，你知道，我说过，你为此获得了太多的赞誉。

sentences.en: But one thing he did, you know, I told, I said, you were given so much credit for that.
sentences.zh: 我两天前听说，你卖出的开利空调比你预想的要多得多，仅仅是因为这是一种爱国举动。

sentences.en: And I heard two days ago that you're selling far more Carrier air conditioners than you thought just as a patriotic move.
sentences.zh: 人们购买开利是因为你所做的事情，把工作岗位带回了印第安纳州。

sentences.en: People are buying Carrier because of what you did, bringing the jobs back to Indiana.
sentences.zh: 人们购买开利是因为你所做的事情，把工作岗位带回了印第安纳州。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: So I said that.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时就是这么说的。

sentences.en: I thought that was going to happen.
sentences.zh: 我预料到会发生这种事。

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，总统先生。

sentences.en: Does being on one of these councils mean that you're a supporter of the president?
sentences.zh: 加入这些委员会之一，是否意味着你是总统的支持者？

sentences.en: Well, that was the fine line and needle that so many of these people were trying to thread.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这正是许多人试图走的一条钢丝，试图在其中寻找平衡。

sentences.en: If you actually look, most of these people or many of these people were not supporters of his.
sentences.zh: 如果你仔细观察，会发现这些人中的大多数，或者说很多人，其实并不是他的支持者。

sentences.en: What a lot of these people would say to themselves is, A, when the president calls, there's a duty to participate.
sentences.zh: 很多人会对自己说，首先，当总统召唤时，有参与的义务。

sentences.en: A, B, from a business perspective, we think we have a view and we'd like a seat at the table on some of these big policy issues that might impact business.
sentences.zh: 其次，从商业角度来看，我们有自己的观点，并且希望在一些可能影响商业的重大政策问题上有一席之地。

sentences.en: Health care impacts business.
sentences.zh: 医疗保健影响商业。

sentences.en: Taxes impact business.
sentences.zh: 税收影响商业。

sentences.en: Immigration impacts business.
sentences.zh: 移民影响商业。

sentences.en: Climate impacts business.
sentences.zh: 气候影响商业。

sentences.en: So there are these big issues and these CEOs want to be there and discuss them.
sentences.zh: 所以存在这些重大议题，而这些首席执行官们希望参与其中并进行讨论。

sentences.en: In fact, they had actually broken out into groups and done all sorts of work that they were trying to come back to advise the president on.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们已经分成了小组，做了各种各样的工作，试图回来向总统提供建议。

sentences.en: How angry are business leaders that the president asked them to put themselves and their reputations and their companies'
sentences.zh: 商业领袖们对于总统要求他们将自己、他们的声誉以及他们公司的

sentences.en: identities kind of on the line for him in these councils and then did something that they felt kind of implicated?
sentences.zh: 身份在这些委员会中为他冒险，然后又做了一些他们觉得被牵连的事情，感到有多愤怒？

sentences.en: Let me get you a text.
sentences.zh: 让我给你看条短信。

sentences.en: Please.
sentences.zh: 请吧。

sentences.en: Because I think it speaks directly to this.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得这直接说明了这一点。

sentences.en: So you've gotten text from these folks.
sentences.zh: 所以你收到了这些人的短信。

sentences.en: For somebody who's been involved in all of this, he sent me this this afternoon after literally within about an hour after this council unraveled.
sentences.zh: 对于一个一直参与其中的人来说，他在这个委员会解散后不到一小时，就给我发了这条短信。

sentences.en: And he was trying to explain to me what really pushed the group over the top.
sentences.zh: 他试图向我解释到底是什么让这个群体彻底崩溃了。

sentences.en: And part of it was the comments on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是周二的评论。

sentences.en: But part of it was what he said in reaction to Walmart's CEO, Doug McMillan, who had issued a statement to his employees condemning not only the violence in Charlottesville,
sentences.zh: 但部分原因是他对沃尔玛首席执行官道格·麦克米伦的回应，后者曾向员工发表声明，不仅谴责了夏洛茨维尔的暴力事件，

sentences.en: but the way the president had reacted.
sentences.zh: 还谴责了总统的反应方式。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the president, in a sense, went after Doug McMillan, the CEO of Walmart, and said, So the head of Walmart, who I know, who's a very nice guy, was making a political statement.
sentences.zh: 总统在某种意义上攻击了沃尔玛首席执行官道格·麦克米伦，他说：所以，我认识的沃尔玛负责人，一个非常好的人，是在发表政治声明。

sentences.en: So let me just read you a text.
sentences.zh: 让我给你读一下短信。

sentences.en: They thought that he was polite and respectful.
sentences.zh: 他们认为他表现得礼貌且尊重。

sentences.en: He was not treated appropriately.
sentences.zh: 他没有得到应有的对待。

sentences.en: And that was a wake-up call to some.
sentences.zh: 这对一些人来说是一个警钟。

sentences.en: He was polite in his criticism of the president.
sentences.zh: 他在批评总统时很礼貌。

sentences.en: And the president called it political.
sentences.zh: 而总统却称之为政治行为。

sentences.en: That didn't go over well.
sentences.zh: 这让人很不舒服。

sentences.en: The CEOs thought, well, you can't even give constructive criticism.
sentences.zh: 首席执行官们心想，好吧，连建设性的批评都不能提吗？

sentences.en: This is what we signed up for?
sentences.zh: 这就是我们加入的原因吗？

sentences.en: Don't underestimate how disappointed and angry the CEOs were with how Trump treated the Walmart CEO, who was very well liked by the group,
sentences.zh: 不要低估首席执行官们对特朗普对待沃尔玛首席执行官方式的失望和愤怒，他在群体中非常受欢迎，

sentences.en: not to mention the president's comments as a whole.
sentences.zh: 更不用说总统整体的评论了。

sentences.en: At this point, Andrew, what is the future of President Trump's relationship with American business leaders?
sentences.zh: 安德鲁，在这一点上，特朗普总统与美国商业领袖关系的未来会怎样？

sentences.en: It's complicated.
sentences.zh: 这很复杂。

sentences.en: I think there will continue to be a relationship in large part because there's policy decisions that have to get made and will have big impacts on business.
sentences.zh: 我认为这种关系会持续下去，很大程度上是因为必须做出政策决定，而且这些决定会对商业产生重大影响。

sentences.en: And if you read Ginny Rometty, who's the CEO of IBM's memo to her employees, she still said that the company was committed to working with the government.
sentences.zh: 如果你读一下IBM首席执行官吉妮·罗曼提给员工的备忘录，她仍然表示公司致力于与政府合作。

sentences.en: So they will do that.
sentences.zh: 所以他们会那样做。

sentences.en: I just think they'll probably do it in private.
sentences.zh: 我只是认为他们可能会私下进行。

sentences.en: They won't do it as part of these public councils.
sentences.zh: 他们不会再作为这些公开委员会的一部分来做。

sentences.en: They will still lobby for the things that they care about.
sentences.zh: 他们仍然会为他们关心的事情进行游说。

sentences.en: They just won't necessarily associate and attach themselves in the way they had through these councils.
sentences.zh: 他们只是不一定会像通过这些委员会那样去关联和附属于他。

sentences.en: Andrew, thank you.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的事情。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, President Trump's personal lawyer, John Dowd, forwarded an incendiary email to Washington lawyers and journalists.
sentences.zh: 周三，特朗普总统的私人律师约翰·多德向华盛顿的律师和记者转发了一封煽动性的电子邮件。

sentences.en: The email portrayed Confederate General Robert E.
sentences.zh: 这封邮件用溢美之词描述了邦联将军罗伯特·E·

sentences.en: Lee in glowing terms, claimed that terrorists have infiltrated the FBI and Black Lives Matter, and said protesters should, quote, go back to the ghettos.
sentences.zh: 李，声称恐怖分子已经渗透到联邦调查局和“黑人的命也是命”运动中，并称抗议者应该“滚回贫民窟”。

sentences.en: In a brief phone call, Dowd told the Times, quote, people send me things.
sentences.zh: 在一次简短的电话中，多德告诉《时报》：“人们给我发东西。”

sentences.en: I forwarded them.
sentences.zh: “我转发了它们。”

sentences.en: Then he hung up.
sentences.zh: 然后他就挂断了电话。

sentences.en: And…
sentences.zh: 而且……

sentences.en: Heather Heyer, the 32-year-old killed in Charlottesville last weekend by a suspected white nationalist, was remembered on Wednesday for a relentless passion for fighting injustice.
sentences.zh: 上周末在夏洛茨维尔被一名疑似白人至上主义者杀害的32岁的希瑟·海耶，周三被人们缅怀，她对打击不公正有着不懈的热情。

sentences.en: She was a firm believer in whatever she believed.
sentences.zh: 她坚定地相信她所信仰的一切。

sentences.en: And let's do that.
sentences.zh: 让我们这样做吧。

sentences.en: Let's find that spark of conviction.
sentences.zh: 让我们找到那点信念的火花。

sentences.en: Let's find in ourselves that action.
sentences.zh: 让我们在自己身上找到那种行动力。

sentences.en: Let's spread this.
sentences.zh: 让我们传播开来。

sentences.en: Let's have the uncomfortable dialogue.
sentences.zh: 让我们进行那场不舒服的对话。

sentences.en: It ain't easy sitting down and saying, well, why are you upset?
sentences.zh: 坐下来问“你为什么难过？”并不容易。

sentences.en: Her mother, Susan Brough, addressed the hundreds of mourners packed into a Charlottesville theater, many of them wearing purple, her favorite color.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲苏珊·布罗向挤在夏洛茨维尔剧院里的数百名哀悼者发表了讲话，他们中的许多人穿着她最喜欢的颜色——紫色。

sentences.en: And I think the reason that what happened to Heather has struck a chord is because we know that what she did is achievable.
sentences.zh: 我认为希瑟身上发生的事情之所以引起共鸣，是因为我们知道她所做的是可以实现的。

sentences.en: We don't all have to die.
sentences.zh: 我们不必都去死。

sentences.en: We don't all have to sacrifice our lives.
sentences.zh: 我们不必都牺牲我们的生命。

sentences.en: They tried to kill my child to shut her up.
sentences.zh: 他们试图杀掉我的孩子来让她闭嘴。

sentences.en: Well, guess what?
sentences.zh: 好吧，你猜怎么着？

sentences.en: You just magnified her.
sentences.zh: 你反而放大了她的影响力。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人激动的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《地铁》的最新一集中，和我一起，莎拉·凯尼格，讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在你获取播客的任何地方收听。

sentences.en: You can see the great taste.
sentences.zh: 你可以看出这品味很棒。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。
